papers: 10.1111/2041-210x.70326 [verified; C, D, Crossref] (Mulvey et al. 2026, Methods in Ecology and Evolution)
release_scan: CRAN 1.2.1, 2026-09-22 [verified; C, D]; GitHub v1.2.0, 2026-05-04 [verified; C, D]
notes: C: end-to-end with FossilSim, TreeSim and SimClock for RevBayes and BEAST 2 total-evidence tests (from a university news item; abstract text not retrieved). D: discrete morphological character simulation with stratigraphic extensions; new in 2026; used in the Lorentz 2026 workshop; D's peer-review status and independent validation were not assessed.

name: paleoAM
summary: Fits abundance models along gradients and simulates assemblages under time-averaging, bioturbation, sedimentation rate and sampling to test detectability of abrupt environmental change.
papers: 10.26879/1282 [verified; Crossref] (Belanger & Bapst 2023, Palaeontologia Electronica)
notes: Lesser-known. The only packaged R time-averaging simulator found (D).

name: paleobuddy
summary: Simulates birth-death with trait-, environment- and diversity-dependent rates, plus fossil sampling and phylogenies, for ground-truth tests.
method_family: Simulation; birth-death-sampling simulation; diversification and sampling simulator
papers: 10.1111/2041-210x.13996 [verified; B, C, D] (do Rosario Petrucci, Januario, Quental 2022, Methods in Ecology and Evolution)
release_scan: CRAN 1.1.0, 2025-02-05 [verified; B, C, D]; GitHub v1.1.0, 2025-06-11 [verified; B, C, D]
notes: B: in inventory; pair with DeepDive and divDyn for simulate-and-score validation. C: used to validate the treeless skyline FBD-range model in RevBayes (brpetrucci/skyfbdr_simstudy, 1000 coverage runs).

name: paleotree
summary: Time-scaling of fossil phylogenies, ML estimators of sampling and diversification from ranges and occurrences, and simFossilRecord simulation.
method_family: ML birth-death-sampling; simulation; time-scaling; fossil-lineage simulation
papers: 10.1111/j.2041-210x.2012.00223.x [verified; B, C, D] (Bapst 2012, Methods in Ecology and Evolution); cal3 10.1111/2041-210x.12081 [verified; C] (Bapst 2013); time-scaling comparison Bapst 2014, Paleobiology, DOI 10.1666/13033 [unverified; C, derived from a BioOne URL]
release_scan: CRAN 3.4.7, 2024-07-06 [verified; B, C, D]; GitHub v3.4.4-CRAN-release, 2022-05-06 [verified; B]
maintenance_scan: slow/active (push 2026-07-22) [verified; B] | slow-active (pushed 2026-07-22) [C] | slow on CRAN; GitHub pushed 2026-07-22 [D]
notes: B: CRAN DESCRIPTION: likelihood functions for sampling and diversification rates from range and occurrence data, simFossilRecord simulator [verified; CRAN]. C: simFossilRecord tracks morphotaxon identity so pseudoextinction can be counted; longevity-dependent rates give a hook for age-dependent extinction tests; simulates fossil records with ancestor-descendant, time-, longevity- and diversity-dependent rates.

name: PartiMoDe
languages: MATLAB (uses pdepe; will not run in Octave)
summary: PDE model of particle movement, destruction and age-depth structure in the sediment surface mixed layer (time-averaging, stratigraphic disorder).
papers: 10.5281/zenodo.13169644 [verified; D, Zenodo software citation] (Hohmann 2024)
blockers: BLOCKER: MATLAB (README says explicitly it will not run in Octave)
notes: Companion 2026 paper code StratRecRes_supp (R >= 4.2, MATLAB optional, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.20813310) argues that sediment accumulation, not mixing, controls temporal resolution; the R analysis uses stored MATLAB outputs (D).

name: StratPal
summary: Simulates time-domain processes (traits, ranges, events) and their expression in the stratigraphic record via age-depth, niche and taphonomy models.
method_family: Observation-model simulation; stratigraphic-filter simulation; stratigraphic forward modelling; forward model of the rock record
papers: 10.1111/2041-210X.14507 [verified; A, B, C, D] (Hohmann first author, with Jarochowska [snippet; A]; 'StratPal: an R package for creating stratigraphic paleobiology modeling pipelines', Methods in Ecology and Evolution, 2025; two authors per Crossref [D]); preprint 10.1101/2024.11.22.624834 [verified; D]; 10.1186/s12862-024-02287-2 [verified; B] (Hohmann et al. 2024; B lists it for the combined StratPal and admtools row)
release_scan: CRAN 0.7.1, 2025-12-06 [verified; A, B, C, D]; GitHub v0.7.0, 2025-12-04 [verified; D]
maintenance_scan: active; pushed 2026-10-08 [verified; A, C, D] | active [B]
blockers: install.packages; imports admtools, paleoTS [verified; A]; pure R [B]
notes: A: workshops and supplement repos; Shiny apps ShellbedCondensator and DarwinCAT [verified; GH]; closest existing tool to a 'stratigraphic filter' test. B: same group has stratorder, stratcols, CarboKitten.jl (GPL-3.0, pushed 2026-10-20) and anchoring-late-devonian-mass-extinction code [verified; GH]. C: cross-domain; pipelines pass simulated lineages and traits through stratigraphic models (distortion, condensation); 'probably another scan's domain'. D: B-007's own note calls it 'filtering machinery, not calibration'; workshop materials StratPal_workshop_materials (2025-12-19) and Zenodo 14001502 [snippet; D].
